name: A photographic print on paper (salted paper, albumen, cyanotype, gelatin silver): the image in the paper's surface

diffuseAlbedo.note: The reflectance a photograph of the print's white stands for: a first value for a paper's white, until a print is measured. The paper's tone as it has aged is in the photograph itself.

refractiveIndex.note: The paper's cellulose and the albumen or gelatin binder over it lie near the same index.

wettingDepth.note: A print is a single thin sheet: water reaches all of it.
